full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 3/5/14 and 19 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and contending interalia, that the suit is not maintainable in its present form, barred by the law of limitation and also for defect of parties; Their further case is that the suit land originally belonged to Someruddin and Sher Ali in equal share; Sher Ali died leaving two sons Osman Ali and Abdul Ali; Kashem Ali obtained 1.29 acres of land of Plot No.960 from Osman Ali and Abdul Ali on 05.05.1942 through pattan and Osman Ali received rent from Kashem Ali for the years 1349-1352 B.S. admitting Kashem Ali as an under rayat of Osman Ali who executed and registered dakhila on 16.04.1946; Sahed Ali pur-chased Marsha right from Osman Ali and Abdul Ali on 27.02.1946; Sahed Ali gave pattan through unregistered dakhila to Kashem Ali on 11.11.1946 and the said pattan was made during revisional survey and for that reason R.S. and S.A. Khatians were not published in the name of Kashem Ali; Though the land.was not recorded in S.A. Khatian in the name of Kashem Ali but he had been owning and possessing said land through pattan; Sahed Ali and Abdul Ali transferred 1.42 acres of land of Khatian No.955 on 05.11.1955 to Hatem Ali, Yousuf Ali, Hochen Ali and Kashem Ali; By virtue of the said deed Kashem Ali acquired 35½ of land; Kashem Ali being the owner of 1.64½ of land by way of pattan and kabala executed registered will infavour of his two sons and others i.e. Defendant Nos.3/14 Dholu Kha and Asmot Ali; Said Dholu Kha died leaving wife Nurjahan Begum, son Delowar Hossain and 3 daughters namely Rahima, Halima and Reba; Kashem Ali took pattan of 65 decimals of land trom Haji Hachonuddin Talukder on 22.12.1952 from C.S. Khatian No.410 and subsequently transferred the said land to Kobbat. Ali; Sobder, Sadar, Hachon Uddin and Hochon Uddin were owners and possessor of the land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.545 in equal share; Sobder Ali died leaving two sons and 3 daughters namely Arshed Ali, Kodom Ali, Borujan, Mayajan and Dwitiya Bibi where each son got 1.01 acres of land and each daughter got 50½ of land; Sadar Ali died leaving his mother Meherjan and two cousin Arshed Ali and Kodom Ali as heirs and they sold their 4 annas share to Haji Hachonuddin Talukder, Ketab Ali, Ahad Ali and Arena Bibi on 25.04.1941; Arshed Ali died leaving two sons Ketab Ali and Akkel Ali; Akkel Ali died leaving his full brother Ketab Ali as heirs; Ketab Ali (son of Arshed Ali) transferred his land to Ketab Ali (son of Haji Hachonuddin Talukder) on 12.03.1940 through pattan and gave dakhila admitting him as under tenant and in the said pattan the share of Borujan and Mayajan was not included; Dwitiya Bibi transferred 50½ decimals of land to Haji Hachonuddin Talukder; Again Borujan Bibi transferred 50½ decimals of land to Haji Hachonuddin Talukder on 21.10.1953; In this way Haji Hachonuddin Talukder obtained 5.54 acres of land amongst which 4.58½ acres of land was his recorded land and he transferred 1.89½ acres of land to Azahar Ali and Paribanu; Said Paribanu sold her portion of land to the defendants on 19.07.1979; Rest land of Haji Hachonuddin Talukder was put in auction and Sirajuddin and others purchased 4.86 acres of land in that auction; Against the said auction Yousuf Ali filed Case No.38/1967 in the 1st Munsif Court of Patuakhali to set-aside the auction. In the said case the auction purchaser amicably released 90 decimals of land infavour of Yousuf Ali; On the death of Yousuf Ali this defendants inherited said 90 decimals of land; Ketab Ali son of Haji Hachonuddin Talukder acquired 1.90 acres of land by way of pattan and kabala and thereafter died leaving wife Borujan, one son Hochen and father Haji Hachonuddin Talukder as heirs; Said Hochen Ali died leaving wife Rejia and two consanguine paternal uncle Hatem Ali and Yousuf Ali; Rejia sold 23 decimals of land on 09.04.1979 to Defendant Nos.3/19 and Plaintiff No.1 jointly; Haji Hachonuddin Talukder being owner of four annas of land of C.S. Khatian No.545 died leaving wife Amina Bibi and one son Ahad Ali; Said Amina Bibi died leaving one son Ahad Ali; Said Ahad Ali being the owner of 5.32 acres of land died leaving two sons Sekander Ali and Tajem Ali; Said Tajem Ali sold 22 decimals of land of S.A. Khatian No.954 to Abdul Khobir on 31.03.1964; In this way the defendants acquired 7.01½ of land of S.A. Khatian No.954 by way of inheritance and purchase and have been using and possessing their portion of land peacefully; Plaintiffs' filed this suit with false and baseless claim which is liable to be dismissed.
